items.text: Two Fed policymakers leaned further toward tightening: Governor Waller said a half-point move should be considered if inflation stays hot, and St. Louis Fed president Musalem said up to four more hikes may be needed by spring. Futures put about 95% on a quarter-point hike on 9 December.
items.source: speeches as reported on the wires

items.text: US aircraft struck a Revolutionary Guards missile launch site on Qeshm Island, which a US official called self-defense; Iran reports little damage. It is the third US strike day on Iranian territory this month.
Nvidia reports its fiscal third quarter after the close, five days after its chief executive resigned.
Nvidia reported fiscal third-quarter revenue of $115.8bn against $109.1bn expected and raised next year's growth outlook to 75%.
items.source: company release; consensus per LSEG as reported by Reuters and CNBC
